question: What benefits result from sustained practice of the soul teaching?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from all diseases
The practitioner gains union with yogis
These are presented as outcomes of practice
inference: Sustained practice yields freedom from disease and communion with yogis.
uncertainties: saha+melakam may mean meeting, companionship, or mystical union
plain_english: He becomes freed from all diseases and attains union with the yogis.
